title: Kagamine Len — Sharing Deliciousness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len, Rin, have you found them yet?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I haven't seen them either.
That includes Luka...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, they may be by the lake.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wanna take a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We have been walking quite a lot...
Let's sit down and rest.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why don't you put the snacks down there, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, I'll set them here next to me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not. I'm just resting my eyes...
You too, Miku, Rin. Wake up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If the three of you want to take a nap, then please move further away from the lake.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You could've fallen in by accident.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We were this close to the water...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You three seem very tired.
What were you doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! We were looking for you guys...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank goodness. We can finally share with you guys the snacks Mizuki's sister brought back...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-It's gone. The prechel bag Mizuki gave me isn't here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka, did you eat everything again?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What a terrible thing to say. I'm not making that mistake again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Besides, I didn't see any bags at all when we found you three.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, where could it have gone...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was hoping that we could all have some snacks together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah, I figured you dropped this. Here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Does that mean it fell in while you three were sleeping?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, KAITO, wait...!
Mizuki gave us these...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I wish I could've given him some of these snacks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's the one who walked away. The rest of us can eat them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? But we didn't open it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka and I are also seeing this bag for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That just leaves one suspect.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I was able to keep my promise to Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even though he didn't have them with us? He went and ate these on his own.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we split up the rest amongst ourselves?
